before.requirement: Reach an empty-buffer result whose encoding reflects an explicit encoding such as encoding_utf16_le.
before.reason: The old empty branch returned make_parse_result without assigning the resolved encoding. The result constructor initialized encoding to encoding_auto, so this result did not exist before g0001.

after.requirement: Reach the new empty-buffer result with encoding equal to an explicit choice such as encoding_utf16_le.
after.reason: The new empty branch assigns the resolved encoding, but every fixed harness call omits the encoding argument. Its default is encoding_auto, which resolves to encoding_utf8 for zero bytes.

source_evidence.quote:
// Load document from buffer. Copies/converts the buffer, so it may be deleted or changed after the function returns.
		xml_parse_result load_buffer(const void* contents, size_t size, unsigned int options = parse_default, xml_encoding encoding = encoding_auto);

claims.reason: The explicit-encoding result was absent before g0001. After g0001 it exists, and the fixed harness cannot reach it because it never passes an explicit encoding.

before.requirement: Reach status_ok when loading a zero-length buffer with parse_fragment.
before.reason: The old empty branch selected status_ok only when options included parse_fragment. The fixed harness used default, minimal, and full options, none of which includes that flag.

source_evidence.quote:
// early-out for empty documents to avoid buffer allocation overhead
		if (size == 0) return make_parse_result((options & parse_fragment) ? status_ok : status_no_document_element);

after.requirement: Reach status_ok when loading a zero-length buffer with parse_fragment.
after.reason: The new empty branch retains the same parse_fragment status condition. The fixed harness still supplies no options containing parse_fragment.

claims.reason: The same fixed options omit parse_fragment on both sides. The encoding assignment added by g0001 does not change this status condition.
